summary: Learn requisition, RFQ, purchase-order and invoice controls in five days. Explore the course outline and build practical purchasing skills.
lede: Purchasing management training covers the controls for moving routine buying requests from specification and approval through ordering and receipt. For purchasing assistants, buyers and procurement supervisors, it develops skills in checking requisitions, preparing RFQs, comparing quotations and reviewing delegated approvals. Learners also practise three-way invoice matching, goods-receipt checks and digital workflow records, with introductory coverage of sustainable purchasing and supplier due diligence.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who handle purchase requests, supplier offers, purchase orders or invoice checks and need a consistent way to move routine purchases through approval and receipt controls.
prerequisites: This foundation-level course suits learners new to purchasing as well as staff who support routine buying. Familiarity with purchase requests, supplier quotations or invoice records is useful but not required. Coding is not required.
